en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of an industrial complex beside a body of water and surrounding fields. The facility has long factory buildings with pitched roofs, a tall smokestack, several cylindrical silos, smaller outbuildings, and nearby roads and farmland. In the lower‑right corner there is a printed logo with the text "HAMMAR." The image has the aesthetic of a mid‑20th‑century industrial postcard.
